title: Development
intro: The first picture next to what you understand today. The baseline is always kept; the current understanding grows with each review.

baseline.title: Initial baseline
baseline.noneHint: The baseline keeps the first picture from the family and the kindergarten. Create it when the profile is filled in.
baseline.historyHint: Every baseline is kept. Nothing is overwritten.
baseline.confirmBody: This saves a new snapshot of the profile as it is today, for example after the family answered more questions. Earlier baselines stay in the history.

current.title: Current understanding
current.fromReview: Approved in a development review on {date}
current.fromBaseline: The first picture from the baseline. It has not been reviewed yet.
current.noneHint: It starts with the baseline and grows with each development review.

validation.title: How the first picture holds up
validation.hint: One or two observations are not enough to be sure. These are impressions to keep checking, not conclusions.

evidence.none: No linked observations yet — keep observing

reviews.title: Past reviews
reviews.noneHint: Review development when you have a few observations since the baseline.
reviews.aiDraftMissing: The AI draft is no longer available.

review.title: Review development
review.intro: Look at what you have seen since the baseline, decide about each focus and approve the current understanding. Nothing changes until you approve.
review.noObservationsSince: No observations since the baseline of {date} yet
review.noBaseline: There is no baseline yet, so every observation so far is used. You can still review.

start.title: How would you like to start?
start.suggestHint: A draft from the observations since the baseline, in careful, observational words. You check and change everything.
start.blankHint: Start with an empty summary. The lists start from the current understanding.

suggestion.check: This is only a suggestion. Keep what matches what you have seen and change the rest.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.hint: When we will look again, what changed and the next step. Only you fill this in: a suggestion never does.
followUp.reassessmentHint: The date of the next look at the plan.
followUp.involvement: Next step with the family or the team
followUp.involvementHint: Only you choose this. A suggestion never fills it in.

focus.hint: How has each focus gone since the baseline, and what happens next?
focus.none: There is no active focus right now.
focus.full: Up to {max} focus areas at a time. Pause or close one to add another.

validation.hint: For each first impression: do the observations so far support it?
validation.none: There is nothing from the baseline to check yet.

understanding.hint: This becomes the current understanding. The strengths, interests and what helps you approve are added to the profile.
understanding.summaryHint: Describe what you see, for example “appears to enjoy building with one friend”. Avoid labels.

review.limited: This rests on only a few observations so far. You can still choose it.
review.approveHint: Saving keeps the baseline as it is and adds this review to the timeline.
review.unsafe: Please describe what you see in everyday, observational words, without labels.
review.summaryRequired: Please write a short summary first.
review.warningsTitle: Saved. Some choices rest on only a few observations
review.warningsBody: That is fine. Keep observing and look again at the next review.
review.wordingSaved: Saved. The details of the next step use words we usually avoid. You may want to reword them.

overTime.title: Understanding over time
overTime.hint: From the first picture to today. Every step is kept, and each review was approved by a teacher.

compare.title: Original and latest baseline
compare.hint: Every baseline is kept as it was. Compare the first picture with the latest one.

summary.title: Short summary
summary.intro: A general description, main strengths, areas for support, adaptations, follow-up with the family and recommendations for the team.
summary.noneHint: Write it yourself or start from a draft. It counts only once you approve it.
summary.historyHint: Every version is kept. Nothing is overwritten.

fields.follow_up_with_parents: Continued follow-up and working with the family

editor.title: Short summary
editor.aiNote: This draft was made from the observations without the child's name. Check and change everything before you approve it.
editor.unsafe: Please describe what you see in everyday, observational words, without labels.
editor.empty: Write at least one part of the summary first.
